title: Creamy Portuguese Farfalle Bake
description: A keto-friendly take on the classic Portuguese pasta bake, featuring creamy farfalle and savory flavors.
instructions: Cook the farfalle pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt the cream cheese over medium heat.
Add the grated cheddar cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the diced ham, chopped scallions, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked farfalle pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the cheesy ham mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheddar cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
